body:
Please first seek approval in [Rich Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before opening a feature issue. In the meantime, you can implement a custom column by subclassing `ProgressColumn`; the [progress documentation](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/progress.rst) describes custom columns. `TransferSpeedColumn` assumes byte units, and `TaskProgressColumn` displays `it/s` only when the total is unknown.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
